answers.core: > Gradle integration touches the Android export workflow and build templates, which are core engine/editor components. **`An add-on cannot intercept or modify the export pipeline reliably. Therefore, this feature needs to be built into the engine’s core to work correctly for all Android users.`**
answers.workaround: > Workarounds exist—developers can manually **modify** the `exported Android project to use Gradle—but it’s tedious, fragile, and error-prone`. Automating this in the editor would eliminate manual steps and ensure consistency across exports.

title: Add Gradle build support to the Android editor
